label: Aruba Instant On AP17 (RW) 2x2 11ac Wave2 Outdoor Access Point (R2X16A)
description: Aruba Instant On AP17 (R2X16A) - dual-radio 802.11ac Wave 2 outdoor AP (IP67), 2x2:2 on both bands (300 Mbps 2.4 GHz + 867 Mbps 5 GHz). Single 10/100/1000BASE-T RJ45 with 802.3af PoE-in (13.5 W max); supports Instant On mesh and gateway mode.
